item.title: Show HN: Made Our BI v7 – Free Open Source with All Features (AI, SSO, RLS etc.)
item.summary: We just made our BI v 7.0 product completely open source and free including all enterprise versions. Hence in github downloaded version, you can also get things like AI chat analytics (with bring your own LLM), multi-tenancy, embedding, SSO, RLS, report busting, paginated canned reports etc. Zero functionality difference between Community or Enterprise version. Would love some feedback https://github.com/helicalinsight/helicalinsight Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49165810 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
